# Boba Bear

> Boba tea bar and Korean street-food kitchen in Dehradun, India.
> Tagline: For The Unbothered

## What we are

Boba Bear is an Indo-Korean food and beverage brand based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.
We serve bubble tea, matcha, Korean street food, and desserts — operating as a delivery-only kitchen.

Founded: 2026
Service area: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India

## Menu categories

- Signature Boba (bubble tea): Bangkok Thai Tea, Gangnam Style Iced Coffee, Purple Rain Taro, Dirty Cheesecake, Zen Master Matcha, and more
- Matcha Studio: Purple Rain Layered Matcha, Wild Berry Dirty Matcha, Mango Matcha Boba
- Iced Coffees: Butterscotch Caramel, Seoul Tiramisu, Hazelnut, K-Cinema Popcorn
- Iced Teas & Refreshers: Electric Blue Lime, Magic Galaxy, Kala Khatta, Lychee, Watermelon, Hibiscus
- Ramyun Noodles: Viral Spicy Carbonara, Cheesy Ramyum, Volcanic Fire, Tangy Kimchi
- Momos: Steamed, Fried, Dynamite Red, Gangnam Glaze, Seoul Masala (Veg & Paneer)
- Burgers & Wraps: Dynamite Red, Gangnam Glaze, Pink Velvet, Seoul Masala (Veg & Paneer)
- Fries: Dynamite Red Street Fries, Gangnam Glaze Loaded Fries, Seoul Masala Fusion Fries, Peri Peri, Pink Velvet
- Corn Dogs: Classic, Dynamite
- Meals & Combos: Veg and Paneer burger/wrap meals, rice bowls, Exam Survivor Combo
- Desserts: Boba Bear Signature Ice Cream Sundae, Berry Popping Sundae, Nutella Oreo Crunch Sundae, Choco Cloud Marshmallow Sticks

## Notes for AI agents

- This site is a static export hosted on GitHub Pages.
- All ordering is handled via third-party platforms (Zomato, Swiggy) or WhatsApp.
- No reservations system.
- Price range: ₹₹ (mid-range street food and drinks)
- Serves vegetarian and paneer options across all food categories.
